conditions: A free-form statement continues in a noncharacter context. The leading-ampersand condition concerns splitting a lexical token.
limitations: The statement describes the dated J3/24-007 working text. Compiler behavior and final ISO conformance have separate scopes.
Ordinary noncharacter continuation and token splitting have different next-line conditions. A standalone ampersand and character-context continuations are governed separately.

triggers: A different exact source, a WG5 or J3 correction, changed document scope, or a conflicting governing source.

statement: J3/24-007 puts the continuation ampersand last among nonblank characters of a free-form noncharacter line or last before an inline comment. If a lexical token is split across the line break, the next noncomment line starts with an ampersand as its first nonblank character, immediately followed by the rest of that token.
